description: (Na)₂NaScBr₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaScBr₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaScBr₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.85 Å. Sc is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form ScBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sc-Br bond lengths are 2.64 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Sc atom.
